name: @bojackduy/opencode-herdr-control
description: OpenCode plugin for herdr control — survey workspaces/tabs/panes, run shell commands, launch opencode agents

scripts.prepack: bun run typecheck && bun run build
scripts.release:patch: bun run typecheck && bun run build && npm version patch -m "chore: release %s" && git push personal main && git push personal $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
scripts.release:minor: bun run typecheck && bun run build && npm version minor -m "chore: release %s" && git push personal main && git push personal $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
scripts.release:major: bun run typecheck && bun run build && npm version major -m "chore: release %s" && git push personal main && git push personal $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
